en.hook: Most agentic AI pilots fail to reach production due to weak data pipelines, not models.
en.body:
Most agentic AI pilots fail to reach production due to weak data pipelines, not models. Learn the data engineering practices that enable sustainable scaling and proven ROI.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.
